statement: The independent secondary wired XUSB reference identifies a vendor-specific controller USB interface rather than generic HID; community-compatible output message formats additionally documented by Linux and SDL consumers are wired rumble 8-byte 00 08 00 <left> <right> 00 00 00 and LED 3-byte 01 03 <mode>, but no independent physical-device output capture is available.

applicability.scope: protoR2 179-202 (device class); Linux xpad.c 1569-1579, 1682-1689 and SDL 97-107,199-209. Device-side format proposed by independent host implementations; exact physical actuation not established. Single secondary community summary does not independently specify rumble/LED payload bytes.
